name: blinding dust
desc:
Blinding dust and sand swirls magically around the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Each creature within 5 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a  DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the creature's next turn.
